blocks.en: Experiments collects the 25 protocol sheets behind ReLEAF’s wet-lab work, organized across four experimental stages and paired with downloadable procedures and diagrams.
blocks.text: Experiments collects the 25 protocol sheets behind ReLEAF’s wet-lab work, organized across four experimental stages and paired with downloadable procedures and diagrams.
blocks.zh: 本頁收錄 ReLEAF 濕實驗工作背後的 25 份流程表，依四個實驗階段整理，並附上可下載的流程與步驟圖。

blocks.en: The sheets follow four stages: ten for cloning, eight for protein production, five plant assays and two for the bioreactor. All but one carry the full procedure as a downloadable PDF, down to the reagent volumes and the arm the readout is scored against. The newest is the His-tag detection ELISA, which reads His-tagged protein against a six-point standard curve. Activity is measured instead by the DNPH assay, scaled down twenty-fold onto a 96-well plate. Three sheets produced no result on this wiki: the Bradford assay, large scale extraction, and purification and dialysis.
blocks.text: The sheets follow four stages: ten for cloning, eight for protein production, five plant assays and two for the bioreactor. All but one carry the full procedure as a downloadable PDF, down to the reagent volumes and the arm the readout is scored against. The newest is the His-tag detection ELISA, which reads His-tagged protein against a six-point standard curve. Activity is measured instead by the DNPH assay, scaled down twenty-fold onto a 96-well plate. Three sheets produced no result on this wiki: the Bradford assay, large scale extraction, and purification and dialysis.
blocks.zh: 這些流程表分為四個階段：選殖十份、蛋白質生產八份、植物檢測五份，生物反應器兩份。除一份之外，每一份都帶有可下載的完整流程 PDF，細到試劑體積，以及讀值所對照的實驗組。最新的一份是 His 標籤偵測 ELISA，以六點標準曲線讀取帶 His 標籤的蛋白質。活性則改以 DNPH 檢測量測，並縮小二十倍到 96 孔盤上進行。有三份流程表在本 wiki 上沒有產出結果：Bradford 檢測、大量萃取，以及純化與透析。

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 概覽

blocks.en: ReLEAF makes plant protectants in Bacillus subtilis and tests them on Arabidopsis under salt and heat stress. The wet lab work runs in four stages, and each hands its product to the next: cloning builds the constructs, protein production gets the protectant out of the culture and measures its activity, the plant assays test it, and the bioreactor sheets calibrate the instruments that watch the culture grow.
blocks.text: ReLEAF makes plant protectants in Bacillus subtilis and tests them on Arabidopsis under salt and heat stress. The wet lab work runs in four stages, and each hands its product to the next: cloning builds the constructs, protein production gets the protectant out of the culture and measures its activity, the plant assays test it, and the bioreactor sheets calibrate the instruments that watch the culture grow.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 在 Bacillus subtilis 中製造植物保護劑，並在鹽逆境與熱逆境下以 Arabidopsis 測試。濕實驗工作分四個階段進行，每個階段都把產物交給下一個：選殖建出構築，蛋白質生產把保護劑從培養液裡取出並量測其活性，植物檢測加以測試，而生物反應器的流程表則校正看顧培養生長的儀器。

attrs.en: Experiments. Two team members in white coats and gloves pipette at a bench crowded with media bottles.
attrs.zh: 實驗流程。兩位團隊成員穿著白袍、戴著手套，在擺滿培養液瓶的實驗檯前操作微量吸管。

attrs.en: Summary

Whole-project experiment map: cloning in E. coli, electroporation into B. subtilis, bioreactor culture, secreted protectants, plant model testing on agar, soil and hydroponics, and plant growth evaluation by chlorophyll, root length, leaf area and fresh weight.
attrs.zh: 全專題實驗地圖：在 E. coli 中選殖、電穿孔進入 B. subtilis、生物反應器培養、分泌出的保護劑、在瓊脂、土壤與水耕上的植物模式測試，以及以葉綠素、根長、葉面積與鮮重評估植物生長。

attrs.en: Protocol groups
attrs.zh: 流程分組

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for culture agar preparation: weigh LB agar into a flask with water and glycerol, stir, autoclave, cool in the cabinet, add antibiotic, pour plates.
attrs.zh: 培養用瓊脂製備的步驟圖：把 LB agar 稱入裝有水與甘油的燒瓶、攪拌、高壓滅菌、在操作櫃中冷卻、加入抗生素、倒盤。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for PCR amplification: assemble the reaction on ice, then run the thermal cycle.
attrs.zh: PCR 擴增的步驟圖：在冰上配製反應液，然後執行溫度循環。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for restriction enzyme digestion: calculate the DNA volume, assemble buffer, enzyme, DNA and water on ice, incubate.
attrs.zh: 限制酵素切割的步驟圖：計算 DNA 體積，在冰上配好緩衝液、酵素、DNA 與水，然後保溫。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for DNA gel electrophoresis: cast the agarose gel with stain, load ladder and samples, run at 100 volts, image.
attrs.zh: DNA 凝膠電泳的步驟圖：灌製含染劑的瓊脂凝膠、上標準品與樣本、以 100 伏特跑膠、拍照。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for Golden Gate assembly: combine vector, inserts, T4 ligase, buffer and type IIS enzyme, then cycle digestion and ligation.
attrs.zh: Golden Gate 組裝的步驟圖：把載體、插入片段、T4 連接酶、緩衝液與 type IIS 酵素混合，然後循環進行切割與連接。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for heat-shock transformation: thaw competent cells on ice, add plasmid, heat shock at 42 degrees, recover in SOC, plate.
attrs.zh: 熱震轉形的步驟圖：在冰上解凍勝任細胞、加入質體、於 42 度熱震、在 SOC 中回復、塗盤。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for electroporation: grow and wash electrocompetent Bacillus subtilis, mix with plasmid in a chilled cuvette, pulse, recover in SOC, plate on selective agar.
attrs.zh: 電穿孔的步驟圖：培養並洗滌具電穿孔勝任能力的 Bacillus subtilis、在預冷的電穿孔槽中與質體混合、施加電脈衝、在 SOC 中回復、塗在選擇性瓊脂上。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for colony PCR: grid a backup plate, pick each colony with a tip, streak it on the grid, drop the tip in a PCR tube with master mix, run the cycle.
attrs.zh: 菌落 PCR 的步驟圖：在備份培養盤上畫格、用吸管尖挑起每一個菌落、在格子上劃線、把吸管尖丟進含 master mix 的 PCR 管、執行循環。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for liquid culture: label tubes, add TB medium and antibiotic, pick a colony with a tip, drop it in, incubate at a slant.
attrs.zh: 液體培養的步驟圖：標記試管、加入 TB 培養液與抗生素、用吸管尖挑起菌落、丟進管中、傾斜放置培養。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for plasmid miniprep: pellet the culture, resuspend, lyse, neutralize, bind to the column, wash, elute, measure on the BioDrop.
attrs.zh: 質體 miniprep 的步驟圖：離心收菌、重新懸浮、裂解、中和、結合到管柱、洗滌、沖提、以 BioDrop 量測。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for the Bradford assay: dilute a BSA standard series, add standards and samples to a 96-well plate with Bradford reagent, incubate, read at 595 nanometers, fit the standard curve.
attrs.zh: Bradford 檢測的步驟圖：稀釋一系列 BSA 標準品、把標準品與樣本加到含 Bradford 試劑的 96 孔盤、保溫、在 595 奈米讀值、擬合標準曲線。

attrs.en: Procedure strip for harvesting the secreted fraction: centrifuge the culture, keep the supernatant, add protease inhibitor, clarify with a second spin.
attrs.zh: 收取分泌部分的步驟條圖：離心菌液、保留上清液、加入蛋白酶抑制劑、再離心一次澄清。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for the cell pellet: pellet 1.5 millilitre aliquots, resuspend each in a different CelLytic B dilution, mix, spin, separate soluble from insoluble fractions.
attrs.zh: 菌體沉澱的步驟圖：把 1.5 毫升的分裝離心成沉澱、各以不同稀釋度的 CelLytic B 重新懸浮、混合、離心、把可溶與不可溶部分分開。

attrs.en: Procedure strip for the large scale supernatant harvest: pellet the induced culture, keep the supernatant, add protease inhibitor, clarify.
attrs.zh: 大量規模收取上清液的步驟條圖：把誘導後的菌液離心成沉澱、保留上清液、加入蛋白酶抑制劑、澄清。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for large scale pellet lysis: harvest cells, resuspend in CelLytic B with lysozyme and protease inhibitor, shake, add DNase I, spin, collect the soluble fraction.
attrs.zh: 大量規模菌體裂解的步驟圖：收取細胞、以含溶菌酶與蛋白酶抑制劑的 CelLytic B 重新懸浮、震盪、加入 DNase I、離心、收集可溶部分。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for Ni-NTA purification: spin off the storage buffer, equilibrate, add imidazole to the supernatant and load it, wash three times, elute at 175 g.
attrs.zh: Ni-NTA 純化的步驟圖：離心去除保存緩衝液、平衡、在上清液中加入咪唑後上樣、洗滌三次、以 175 g 沖提。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for Ni-NTA column regeneration: make 50 millilitres of MES and sodium chloride buffer, pass 30 millilitres through the column, wash with 30 millilitres of water, store in 20 percent ethanol at 4 degrees.
attrs.zh: Ni-NTA 管柱再生的步驟圖：配製 50 毫升的 MES 與氯化鈉緩衝液、取 30 毫升通過管柱、以 30 毫升的水洗滌、在 4 度下以 20% 乙醇保存。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for SDS-PAGE: pour resolver and stacker, set the comb, heat samples in Laemmli buffer, load the ladder at both ends, run at 200 then 120 volts.
attrs.zh: SDS-PAGE 的步驟圖：灌製分離膠與堆積膠、放上梳子、把樣本在 Laemmli 緩衝液中加熱、兩端都上標準品、先以 200 伏特再以 120 伏特跑膠。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for Coomassie staining: wash the gel three times in water, stain for an hour, destain until bands show on a clear background.
attrs.zh: Coomassie 染色的步驟圖：以水洗膠三次、染色一小時、脫色到條帶在乾淨背景上顯現。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for a Western blot: run the gel, build the transfer sandwich onto PVDF, block in milk, incubate with primary and secondary antibodies, detect by chemiluminescence.
attrs.zh: 西方墨點法的步驟圖：跑膠、把轉印三明治疊到 PVDF 上、以奶粉封阻、與一級及二級抗體作用、以化學發光偵測。

attrs.en: Soil experiment overview: soil medium preparation and sowing, then a salinity arm with pre-treatment, co-treatment at 100 millimolar and further applications at 200 and 300 millimolar, and a heat arm at 37 degrees, ending in fresh weight, root length, harvested seed and rosette area.
attrs.zh: 土壤實驗概覽：培養土的準備與播種，接著是鹽度組，包含前處理、100 毫莫耳的同時處理，以及在 200 與 300 毫莫耳下的後續施用，另有 37 度的熱逆境組，最後以鮮重、根長、採收的種子與蓮座葉面積作結。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for seed sterilization and germination on half MS plates, cold treatment and vertical growth under white light.
attrs.zh: 種子滅菌與在 1/2 MS 培養盤上發芽的步驟圖，含低溫處理與白光下的垂直生長。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for transplanting a seven-day-old seedling into a soil pot, supporting it from beneath the cotyledons and washing soil over the roots.
attrs.zh: 把七日齡幼苗移植到土壤盆的步驟圖：從子葉下方托住幼苗，再把土沖洗覆蓋到根部。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for post-transplant care: tray watering, stepping down humidity under a lid, alternating fertilizer, staking the inflorescence and collecting seed.
attrs.zh: 移植後照顧的步驟圖：底盤給水、在蓋子下逐步降低濕度、交替施肥、為花序立支架，以及採種。

attrs.en: Workflow strip for the agar assay: pour plates, sow seeds with the template, vernalize, transfer seedlings to treatment plates, photograph on the black stand.
attrs.zh: 瓊脂檢測的流程條圖：倒盤、依模板播種、低溫春化、把幼苗移到處理盤、在黑色拍攝架上拍照。

attrs.en: Seed template for a square agar plate: two rows of nine ticks, the first row 3 centimetres from the top, the rows 5 centimetres apart, and 4 centimetres below the second row.
attrs.zh: 方形瓊脂培養盤的播種模板：兩排各九個刻度，第一排距上緣 3 公分，兩排相距 5 公分，第二排下方 4 公分。

attrs.en: Timeline of the agar salinity test: sowing and vernalization, germination, transfer onto treatment plates, then daily imaging and harvest into root length, fresh weight and chlorophyll.
attrs.zh: 瓊脂鹽度測試的時間軸：播種與春化、發芽、移到處理盤，然後每日拍照，最後採收並量測根長、鮮重與葉綠素。

attrs.en: Procedure panels for hydroponic salinity testing: overview from seed to germination rack to treatment box, preparing 1 percent MS agar, punching Eppendorf lids, planting seeds in the lids over a 48-well rack, and preparing 3 molar NaCl in half MS medium.
attrs.zh: 水耕鹽度測試的步驟圖組：從種子到發芽架再到處理箱的概覽、配製 1% MS 瓊脂、在 Eppendorf 管蓋上打孔、把種子種在架於 48 孔盤上的管蓋裡，以及在 1/2 MS 培養液中配製 3 莫耳的 NaCl。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for heat stress on agar: vernalize and germinate, transfer seedlings to four plates, spray the peptide one day before, on the day, or one day after 37 degree thermopriming, and image daily.
attrs.zh: 瓊脂上熱逆境的步驟圖：春化並發芽、把幼苗移到四個培養盤、在 37 度熱預處理的前一天、當天或後一天噴施胜肽，並每日拍照。

attrs.en: Procedure diagram for chlorophyll extraction: lift and weigh the seedlings, freeze them with steel beads, extract in 80 percent acetone, load a 96-well plate, read at 663 and 645 nanometers.
attrs.zh: 葉綠素萃取的步驟圖：取起幼苗並秤重、與鋼珠一起冷凍、在 80% 丙酮中萃取、上 96 孔盤、在 663 與 645 奈米讀值。
